subject: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions
body:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions

Hi Avery — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side:

- Goal: 45–60 minute demo focused on integration footprint (VPC options), latency expectations, and a short Q&A for security/procurement.
- Ask: please confirm who from your InfoSec and Procurement teams should join so we can include the right technical folks.

Proposed 3 windows next week (PT):
  * Tue 2026-10-13 09:30–10:30
  * Wed 2026-10-14 11:00–12:00
  * Thu 2026-10-15 13:00–14:00

Attached: MVP_demo_agenda.pdf (agenda + proposed demo script) and security_evidence_checklist.xlsx (quick list of docs we typically share). If none of those slots work, send two windows that do.

Cc'ing Kimberly Park from our compliance team to make introductions. I’ll pull in Karthik (platform) once we lock timing and stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai

---

From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions

Hi Logan — thanks for the recap. All sounds good. We can do the Wed slot (2026-10-14 11:00–12:00 PT).

Looping in Rajesh (InfoSec) and procurement@brightbridgehealth.com — procurement will confirm the right PO/contract contact but I wanted to get InfoSec in the room for technical questions.

Avery Collins
Director, Data Platforms | BrightBridge Health
avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com

---

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>, procurement@brightbridgehealth.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions

Thanks Avery — locking Wed 2026-10-14 11:00 PT. I’ve created a calendar hold: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (please accept).

Quick notes for the meeting agenda so everyone arrives prepared:
- We will keep the first 20 minutes product walkthrough (infrastructure, VPC/private options, latency numbers for comparable loads).
- 15 minutes for security-specific questions (SOC2, data residency, encryption in transit/at rest).
- Remaining time for procurement/contract Q&A.

Rajesh — welcome. Kimberly (cc'd) will prepare a short evidence packet and the security_evidence_checklist.xlsx attached here. Karthik (cc'd) will cover runtime/network diagrams during the walkthrough.

Action items before Wed: 
1) Rajesh/procurement: please confirm if you need a SOC2 report or specific attestations during the call.
2) Avery: confirm final attendee list (names + roles).
3) Redwood: we’ll circulate the agenda and a short demo recording after the call.

Attachments: MVP_demo_agenda.pdf, security_evidence_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll wait for procurement contact name to add formally.

Best,
Logan

---

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions

Logan — thanks for the invite. Two asks from InfoSec:
1) Please bring the SOC2 Type II attestation (or the link) and the control scope (data-in-scope vs metrics).
2) A simple network flow diagram (how egress flows look, what ports/IPs we should expect) is helpful prior to the call.

If you can drop those before EOD Tue (10/13) that gives us time to triage.

Rajesh Patel
Senior Security Engineer | BrightBridge Health
rajesh.patel@brightbridgehealth.com

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing and security/procurement introductions

Rajesh/Avery — Karthik here (Platform). Quick confirmation on the deliverables from our side: 
- I’ll attach a one-page runtime/network diagram and a short note on VPC peering vs Private Connect approaches before EOD Tue (10/13).
- Kimberly will surface the SOC2 link and a redacted control matrix (we typically provide that via a secure share).
- For procurement: if you can share the procurement contact name we’ll route contract templates and an estimated T&Cs summary before the meeting.

Looking forward — we’ll be ready for Wed 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
